rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「토지이용규제 기본법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임한 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Framework Act on Land Use Regulation and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
[Wholly Amended Aug. 13, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(규제안내서 작성대상 시설) 「토지이용규제 기본법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제2조제7호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 시설”이란 별표와 같다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Facilities Subject to Preparation of Regulatory Guidelines) The term “facilities prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 2, Subparagraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Land Use Regulation (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) is as set forth in the Attached Table. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Aug. 13, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(토지이용계획확인서 등) ①영 제9조제1항에 따른 토지이용계획확인신청서는 별지 제1호서식에 따르며, 같은 조 제3항에 따른 토지이용계획확인서는 별지 제2호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Certificate of Confirmation of Land Use Plan, etc.) ① The application for confirmation of a land use plan pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form, and the certificate of confirmation of a land use plan pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제9조제4항제2호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2010. 11. 1., 2012. 4. 13., 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 4. 17.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 9, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Nov. 1, 2010; Apr. 13, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013; Apr. 17, 2015>
1. Inspection period pursuant to the latter part of Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Land Development Promotion Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「공공주택건설 등에 관한 특별법 시행령」 제8조제2항에 따른 열람기간
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection period pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Construction of Public Housing, etc.
3. A road pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 11, Item B of the Building Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「국토의 계획 및 이용에 관한 법률」 제25조에 따른 도시ㆍ군관리계획 입안사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters for the preparation of urban and county management plans pursuant to Article 25 of the National Land Planning and Utilization Act
5. Farmland with unfavorable farming conditions pursuant to Article 5-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Farmland Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 「공유수면 관리 및 매립에 관한 법률」 제48조에 따른 매립목적 변경 제한
rows.text_en: 6. Restrictions on changing the purpose of reclamation pursuant to Article 48 of the Act on the Management and Reclamation of Public Waters
7. Period of approval for change of use pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 1 of the Mountain Management Act
8. Key Landscape Management Zone pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Landscape Act

rows.source_ko: 9. 지방자치단체가 도시ㆍ군계획조례로 정하는 토지 이용 관련 정보
rows.text_en: 9. Land use-related information determined by local governments through city and county planning ordinances
[Wholly Amended Aug. 13, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(일반 국민에게 제공하는 정보의 내용) 영 제13조제3호에서 “그 밖에 국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 부동산중개업소의 위치정보를 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Contents of Information Provided to the General Public) In Article 13, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, “other matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to location information of real estate brokerage offices. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Aug. 13, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(기초조사의 방식 및 절차 등) ① 「토지이용규제 기본법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제22조의2제1항에 따른 기초조사(이하 “기초조사”라 한다)는 현지답사, 문헌조사, 통계자료의 수집 및 분석 등의 방법으로 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Methods and Procedures of Basic Survey, etc.) ① A basic survey pursuant to Article 22-2, Paragraph 1 of the Framework Act on Land Use Regulation (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) (hereinafter referred to as the “Basic Survey”) may be conducted by methods such as field surveys, literature research, and the collection and analysis of statistical data.

rows.source_ko: ② 국토교통부장관은 다음 각 호의 자료 또는 정보를 기초조사에 활용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may utilize the following data or information for basic investigations.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제12조에 따른 국토이용정보체계에 구축된 자료 또는 정보
rows.text_en: 1. Data or information established in the National Land Use Information System pursuant to Article 12 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「국가공간정보 기본법」 제24조에 따른 국가공간정보통합체계에 구축된 자료 또는 정보
rows.text_en: 2. Data or information established in the National Spatial Information Integration System pursuant to Article 24 of the Framework Act on National Spatial Information

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1호 및 제2호 외에 다른 법령에 따라 운영되는 정보체계에 구축된 자료 또는 정보
rows.text_en: 3. Data or information established in an information system operated under other laws and regulations, other than those specified in Subparagraphs 1 and 2

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 다른 법령에 따라 조사ㆍ측량한 자료
rows.text_en: 4. Other data investigated or surveyed pursuant to other laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: ③ 국토교통부장관은 현지실사 및 주민인식조사 등의 방법으로 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 기초조사의 결과를 검증할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may verify the results of the basic investigation under Paragraphs 1 and 2 through methods such as on-site inspections and resident perception surveys.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제22조에 따라 설치된 토지이용규제평가단은 법 제13조제2항에 따른 지역ㆍ지구등의 지정 실태 등의 평가 및 법 제14조의2제2항 전단에 따른 제도개선 대책의 이행실적 평가에 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 기초조사의 결과를 활용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Land Use Regulation Evaluation Team established pursuant to Article 22 of the Act may utilize the results of the basic surveys under Paragraphs 1 and 2 for the evaluation of the actual status of designation of regions, districts, etc. pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Act and for the evaluation of the performance of implementation of institutional improvement measures pursuant to the first part of Article 14-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 27, 2018]

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on June 8, 2006.
